# 40 USD moved from a USD bank to a USD cash box.
#
# Both splits are USD and the transaction is stated in USD, so nothing in it
# carries a base-currency figure and no cost can be derived from either side.
# The split moving the money *out* establishes no cost basis whatever is
# written on it — it is a spend — and the one moving it in has no cost to be
# read.
#
# The test that uses this writes a `cost_basis_cost` that does not parse onto
# the outgoing split, which is what a hand edit or an older tool can leave in
# a book; the importer refuses such a line at the door.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_verify_costs.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank:USD
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Cash
	type: Cash
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Cash:USD
	type: Cash
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"

2026-02-01 * "Move 40 USD from the bank to the cash box"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:Cash:USD 40.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		value: "40.00"
	Assets:Bank:USD -40.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		value: "-40.00"
